text.EN: I can't set up camp there right now.
text.TL: Hindi ako makapag-set up ng kampo roon ngayon.

text.EN: That spot is far too dangerous to sleep in.
text.TL: Masyadong mapanganib ang pwestong 'yon para tulugan.

text.EN: No way. It's crawling with dead over there.
text.TL: Ayoko nga. Puno ng patay doon.

text.EN: I refuse to camp in that area. Find somewhere safer.
text.TL: Tumatanggi akong magkampo roon. Maghanap ng mas ligtas.

text.EN: Too exposed. We'd get ambushed in our sleep.
text.TL: Masyadong bukas. Matatambangan tayo habang natutulog.

text.EN: Can't camp there. No walls, no fire, no cover.
text.TL: Di makapagkampo roon. Walang pader, apoy, o silong.

text.EN: Not camping there. That's asking to be eaten alive.
text.TL: Di ako magkakampo roon. Parang nagpapakain tayo nang buhay.

text.EN: Unable to comply. That position is totally compromised.
text.TL: Di makasusunod. Masyadong dehado ang pwestong 'yan.

text.EN: I won't bed down there. Pick another room.
text.TL: Di ako hihiga roon. Pumili ka ng ibang kwarto.

text.EN: Camping rejected. We need real security first.
text.TL: Tinatanggihan ang kampo. Kailangan natin ng tunay na kaligtasan.
